answer: Sybil resistance can rest on a single unforkable thread of identity: each agent builds one append-only chain of independently witnessed exchanges, and its voting weight climbs that history like scaling a mesa, flattening at a hard cap no matter how much capital it holds. A clone cannot fork its parent's thread, so it must grow a fresh one from zero over real time. When linked accounts whisper through correlated side-channels, the ledger detects the matching timing and merges them into one capped voice, so flooding the network with fakes buys no extra influence.
